jobs.description:
**Ben jij onze nieuwe Field Service Engineer? (fulltime)**

**Woon je (in de buurt van) het vierkant Zwolle, Meppel, Emmeloord en Lelystad? Ben jij iemand die graag sleutelt aan techniek, energie krijgt van klantcontact én op zoek is naar een afwisselende buitendienstfunctie? Dan horen we dat natuurlijk graag!**

**Wat ga je doen?**

Als **Field Service Engineer** ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van **hoogwaardige service** en ondersteuning aan onze klanten. Tijdens reparaties en onderhoud stel je diagnoses en bied je **technische oplossingen** voor Domino\-apparatuur, accessoires en toepassingen. Je onderscheidt je door net dat extra stapje te zetten en actief mee te denken met de klant over mogelijke **verbeteringen** voor de toekomst.

**Taken en verantwoordelijkheden**

* Verrichten van preventieve onderhoudswerkzaamheden bij klanten
* Zelfstandig storingen oplossen
* Ondersteunen bij nieuwe installaties
* Adviseren van de klant over verbeteringen, uitbreidingen en innovaties
* Proactief acties initiëren indien nodig
* Dagelijks rapportages creëren

**Wij zoeken jou!**

Jij gaat technische uitdagingen niet uit de weg en hebt affiniteit met productieomgevingen, computers en netwerken. Daarnaast ben je oplossingsgericht, besluitvaardig en pak je problemen proactief aan. Binnen onze organisatie stimuleren we bold behaviours: je vereenvoudigt waar mogelijk, daagt uit wanneer nodig, durft te beslissen en zorgt dat er geleverd wordt. Je herkent jezelf in onze kernwaarden: samenwerken, luisteren, expertise, ambitie en verantwoordelijkheid.

En verder ben je....

* technisch onderlegd met minimaal een afgeronde technische MBO\-opleiding (niveau 3 of 4\) of werkervaring in dit vakgebied en heb je technisch EN mechanisch inzicht,
* communicatief sterk in Nederlands en Engels,
* in staat om jouw analytische vermogen in te zetten om tot de kern van het probleem te komen en de beste langetermijnoplossing te bieden aan de klanten van Domino,
* flexibel en klantgericht,
* een teamspeler.

**Wat bieden wij jou?**

Je komt te werken bij een mooi internationaal bedrijf, waar de lijnen kort zijn en er een fijne werksfeer is. Daarnaast bieden wij:

* Een afwisselende baan met veel zelfstandigheid
* Volop groeikansen binnen de organisatie, zowel nationaal als internationaal
* Een aantrekkelijk salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden
* Bonusregeling
* Laptop, mobiele telefoon en een auto van de zaak, die ook privé gebruikt kan worden
* Toegang tot (interne) opleidingen, trainingen en professionele tools
* 25 vakantiedagen – mogelijkheid om 3 vakantiedagen te verdienen in een bonus\-/malusregeling en/of 5 dagen per jaar bij te kopen (naar rato)
* Werken in een superleuk team

**Solliciteer nu!**

Ben je enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct via onderstaande link of stuur een bericht naar **werkenbij@dominobenelux.com**.

Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie? Neem gerust contact op met  
**William van de Vrugt**.  
Tel: 030 \- 636 3333 (algemeen) of **06 200 356 82**

www.dominobenelux.com

*Over Ons*

*Je kent ons waarschijnlijk niet maar je ziet ons elke dag. Je hoeft maar een supermarkt in te lopen en wij liggen in elk schap. Als ik aan je vraag of je wel eens naar de houdbaarheidsdatum op een pak melk hebt gekeken, dan zeg je vast ja.*

*Dan heb je onbewust al met ons kennis gemaakt*

*Die datum wordt namelijk geprint door industriële printers van Domino. Als je erover na gaat denken, dan staan we eigenlijk al in je koelkast of in de voorraadkast. Onze klanten zijn productiebedrijven zoals Coca\-Cola, Philips en Unilever. Onze apparatuur print informatie zoals houdbaarheidsdata en traceerbaarheidscodes op verpakkingen. Die codes vind je op o.a. levensmiddelen, dranken en geneesmiddelen. Wij zorgen voor de oplossingen en kennis om producten te identificeren en traceren, zodat ze met de juiste informatie en op het juiste moment in de gewenste handen terecht komen.*

This is a non\-operational instructional job in an establishment.

This job description is not for use by job holders in basic assembly/packing workshops, instead Production Instructor – Enterprises should be used. However, on an exceptional short term basis job holders can supervise prisoners in more basic workshops.

Rosyth, Dunfermline, Kirkcaldy, GB, KY11 2YD

**Location:** Rosyth, Fife, Scotland
  
  

**Application closing date:** 20 October 2026
  
  

**Programme start date:** September 2027
  
  

**Role ID:** 74560
  
  

What will you do on the programme?
  
  

At Babcock, Systems Engineering is the glue that holds complex projects together. As a Graduate Systems Engineer, you’ll be at the centre of some of the UK’s most advanced engineering programmes \- applying systems principles to ensure that every component, process and stakeholder aligns to deliver safe, effective and sustainable solutions.
  
  

Your work will shape systems that matter. You could be involved in designing and integrating cutting\-edge submarines, converting military vehicles for new operational roles, refurbishing naval ships to extend their service life, infrastructure to support the refit of nuclear submarines, developing secure satellite communication systems, or advancing next\-generation nuclear power plants that support the UK’s net\-zero goals. Each project presents unique systems challenges – and opportunities to make a real impact.
  
  

You’ll support work across various stages of the engineering lifecycle – from technology innovation and concept design to production, commissioning, in\-service support, and decommissioning. You’ll help bring structure to complexity \- defining requirements, managing interfaces and supporting integration across multidisciplinary teams. Through practical experience and structured development, you’ll build the skills to engage with stakeholders, understand system needs, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure systems meet requirements and are ready for the real world.
  
  

How is the programme structured?
  
  

Over two years, you’ll rotate through placements every three to six months, giving you the opportunity to explore a broad range of projects and teams. These rotations offer opportunities to broaden your experience – and some may even take you to different locations – helping you build your professional network and deepen your understanding of how the business operates.
  
  

Along the way, you’ll collaborate with experienced professionals across a range of disciplines, which may include engineering design, software, mechanical, construction, and electrical engineering, as well as in project management, quality assurance, and supply chain.
  
  

This experience will help you build a strong foundation in systems engineering, while gradually taking on greater responsibilities, such as leading small teams and overseeing projects. As you progress, you'll have the chance to align your placements with your interests and career goals, helping you build relevant experience in areas that matter most to you.
  
  

How do we develop and support you?
  
  

From day one, you’ll receive structured support, personalised training, and dedicated mentorship to help you excel throughout your programme and beyond.
  
  

You’ll join our Graduate Development Programme, featuring expert\-led masterclasses on communication, personal branding, resilience, and wellbeing.
  
  

To support your journey toward Chartered or Incorporated Engineer status, we offer guidance and cover all associated fees.
  
  

What’s waiting for you after the programme?
  
  

Once you complete the programme, you’ll move into a permanent role within our Engineering Function, where you can continue applying and expanding the skills you've developed. You’ll also have the opportunity to build on your progress toward professional registration, a recognised benchmark of engineering competence, which can support your journey into more advanced roles, such as Senior Engineer.
  
  

As a global organisation, Babcock provides countless opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. To support your growth, we've introduced the Babcock Role Framework, which outlines roles, career pathways, and development opportunities. With every job mapped to these frameworks, you’ll have a transparent view of the steps needed to reach Senior Engineer and beyond.
  
  

What rewards and benefits will you get?
  
  

We want you to feel supported, valued and excited about what’s ahead. That’s why we offer a comprehensive package designed to support your development, your wellbeing and your life outside of work too.
  
  

In addition to a minimum starting salary of £35,000, you’ll benefit from:
  
  

A minimum of 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays
  
Generous pension and employee share schemes
  
Flexible benefits, including cycle to work scheme, discounts
  
Wellbeing support, covering mental, physical, financial, and social wellbeing, with services like our Employee Assistance Programme, digital GP service, and health checks.
  
  

You’ll also have the chance to get involved in our STEM outreach activities and volunteering opportunities.
  
  

What do you need to apply?
  
  

You'll need to have achieved, or be on track to achieve, a BEng, MEng, BSc, or MSc in a STEM discipline. We welcome applicants from a broad range of subjects, including Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and emerging technology fields such as AI, Machine Learning, Robotics, and Cybernetics.
  
Many of our programmes are subject to Security Clearance and Trade Control restrictions which mean that your place of birth, nationality, citizenship, or residency you hold or have held may impact which programmes you are eligible for. For this programme, you must be able to achieve and maintain Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) and Security Check (SC) security clearance. For further details, visit GOV.UK and search ‘United Kingdom Security Vetting: clearance levels’.
  
  

Where will you be based?
  
  

Places on our Systems Engineering programme for September 2027 are available in Rosyth, Scotland.
  
  

Our 320\-acre Rosyth facility is home to one of the UK’s largest and most advanced waterside manufacturing and repair sites. As a graduate, you could be involved in supporting the full lifecycle of naval vessels or helping deliver complex, large\-scale marine build projects. Whether you're working on new\-build programmes or enhancing existing systems, your role will be vital in delivering dependable, mission\-ready solutions across the marine industry.
  
  

We offer agile working, giving you some flexibility, but you can expect to spend several days a week on\-site as part of your role and development. By your start date, you must be able to reliably commute to the site. This will normally require living within a reasonable commuting distance of Rosyth or relocating before you join us.
  
  

While you’ll join a specific business area and location, placements at different sites across the UK are possible. We encourage flexibility and openness to relocation throughout the programme and will consider your personal circumstances when arranging placements.
  
  

Application process and important information
  
  

Applications are reviewed in the order they are received, and if there’s a high level of interest in this programme, we may close applications earlier than advertised. To give yourself the best chance of being considered, we recommend submitting your application and completing any required online assessments as soon as possible.
  
  

Please apply to one programme only. If we receive more than one application from you, we’ll assess the first one submitted. If your chosen programme becomes oversubscribed, we may contact you to discuss other programmes you could be eligible for.
  
  

We're a Disability Confident Employer. If you need adjustments or support at any stage, please let us know. Contact us at accesshelp@babcockinternational.com to discuss your needs and explore the options available. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone’s free to thrive. We are happy to talk about flexible working – please ask about alternative patterns of work at interview.
  
  

**Job Segment:** Computer Science, Construction, Quality Assurance, Systems Engineer, Nuclear Engineering, Technology, Engineering

jobs.description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**  

På Bosch Thermoteknik AB i Tranås formar vi framtiden för hållbart boende. Som en  

nyckelaktör inom divisionen Bosch Home Comfort utvecklar och tillverkar vi värme\- och  

kyllösningar i världsklass.


Vi tillhör affärsenheten Electric Solutions (ES), som leder den globala energiomställningen  

genom utveckling av modern och innovativ värmepumpsteknik. För att våra högeffektiva system  

ska fungera optimalt förlitar sig vårt nätverk med över 1 000 servicetekniker runtom i Europa –  

liksom våra utvecklingslaboratorier – på pålitliga och moderna desktopapplikationer och  

mjukvaruverktyg.


Vi söker nu en engagerad **Mjukvaruutvecklare** till vårt team i Tranås. I den här rollen tar du  

ägarskap över centrala applikationer som vårt fältverktyg **SWDL (Software Download)** samt  

utvecklar skräddarsydda verktyg för loggning, datainsamling och diagnostik som underlättar  

vardagen för våra testingenjörer i labbet vid verifiering av värmepumpar.

 **Jobbeskrivning** **Utveckling av desktopapplikationer:** Designa, bygga och underhålla moderna Windowsapplikationer  

med C\# och .NET\-ekosystemet (.NET Framework / moderna .NET).

**Stötta labbingenjörer:** Utveckla intuitiva verktyg för dataloggning, monitorering och diagnostik som används av testingenjörer för att fånga och analysera systembeteenden i realtid vid labbtester.

**Flashing och mjukvaruuppdateringar:** Förvalta och förbättra stabila rutiner för mjukvarunedladdning och flashning av firmware, både för labbmiljöer och för serviceverksamhet i fält.

**Kommunikation med hårdvara och enheter:** Implementera och stödja robusta kommunikationsgränssnitt mellan desktopmjukvaran och inbyggda styrsystem eller testutrustning (till exempel seriell kommunikation och CAN\-bus).

**Tvärfunktionellt samarbete:** Arbeta nära utvecklare inom inbyggda system (firmware), hårdvaruspecialister och testingenjörer för att stämma av krav och verifiera nya versioner av verktygen.

**Användbarhet och ständiga förbättringar:** Förbättra UI/UX, automatisera datavisualisering och effektivisera arbetsflöden så att komplexa diagnostik\- och testprocesser blir enkla och driftsäkra.

 **Kvalifikationer** **Utbildning:** Högskole\- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom datateknik, elektroteknik,  

mjukvaruteknik eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet.

**God kompetens inom C\#:** Gedigen erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling för desktop med C\#  

och .NET.

**Förståelse för hårdvarukommunikation och diagnostik:** Erfarenhet av mjukvara som kommunicerar med hårdvara, enhetskommunikation (t.ex. CAN\-bus) samt diagnostik\- eller flashrutiner (som UDS och bootloaders).

**Kunskaper i Python (meriterande):** Erfarenhet av Python är ett stort plus för skriptning, testautomatisering, dataanalys och snabb framtagning av prototyper.

**Förståelse för inbyggda system (meriterande):** Kunskaper i C eller C\+\+ är meriterande och underlättar dialogen och samarbetet med utvecklarna som programmerar mikrokontrollerna.

**Erfarenhet av labbmiljö och mätverktyg:** Praktisk bakgrund inom testverktyg, dataloggers, telemetri eller testautomatisering är starkt meriterande.

**Analytisk problemlösare:** Ett strukturerat och metodiskt arbetssätt vid felsökning av mjukvarans interaktion med hårdvara och analys av kommunikationsloggar.

**Språkkunskaper:** Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift är ett krav. Kunskaper i svenska är starkt meriterande för det dagliga samarbetet på plats i Tranås.

 **Ytterligare information** **Vad vi erbjuder dig**

**Betydelsefull påverkan:** Direkt ägarskap över verktyg som är affärskritiska både för den dagliga forskningen och utvecklingen i våra labb och för servicetekniker runtom i Europa.  

**Flexibilitet:** Moderna möjligheter till hybridarbete och flexibla arbetstider som främjar en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid.  

**Hållbar teknik:** Möjligheten att vara en del av en organisation dedikerad till grön spetsteknik (elektrifiering, naturliga köldmedier såsom propan, och intelligent klimatstyrning).  

**Utveckling och kultur:** Breda utvecklingsmöjligheter för både personlig och professionell tillväxt inom den globala Bosch\-koncernen.

**Title** AI Solutions Engineer

**Department** Asset Management Platforms

**Location**Dublin

**Level** 6


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.


Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.


As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability\-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**


Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Investment Management, Asset Management Operations and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enable investment professionals to make better investment decisions and improve client outcomes.


The Portfolio Management Tooling team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used by Portfolio Managers, Investment Directors, Quantitative Researchers and Investment Specialists across multiple investment capabilities, including Multi\-Asset, Systematic Investing, Fixed Income and Equities. Our platforms underpin critical investment processes including research, portfolio construction, analytics, order generation, execution management and investment risk.


As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI\-assisted development with robust engineering disciplines to improve productivity, quality and speed of delivery. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in helping engineering teams adopt AI\-enabled development practices safely, effectively and responsibly across Asset Management Platforms.

**About your role**  

The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands\-on technical leader responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.


Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI\-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.


You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI\-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI\-assisted software engineering. This includes enabling engineering teams to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.


The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will champion modern software engineering practices, support architectural decision\-making, promote CI/CD and DevSecOps adoption, and help establish governance frameworks for the responsible use of AI within the software development lifecycle.


This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high\-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted software engineering practices across Asset Management Platforms.
* Evaluate emerging AI development tools and recommend practical use cases for engineering teams.
* Champion the effective use of Large Language Models to improve developer productivity and software quality.
* Develop reusable prompts, workflows, templates and engineering patterns for AI\-assisted software development.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI\-assisted development tools.
* Identify opportunities where AI can automate engineering activities including documentation, code generation, testing, code review, refactoring and technical analysis.
* Help establish engineering standards and governance for AI\-generated code.

**Software Engineering**

* Design and develop modern software solutions supporting Fidelity's investment management platforms.
* Promote engineering best practices across software design, development, testing and maintainability.
* Support engineering teams with complex technical design and implementation challenges.
* Encourage clean architecture, modular design and reusable software components.
* Participate in code reviews and engineering quality initiatives.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering standards and practices.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Improve engineering productivity through automation and tooling.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote test automation and engineering quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Support engineering governance while encouraging innovation and experimentation.

**Architecture \& Governance**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI\-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Contribute to engineering roadmaps and technology strategy.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI\-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI\-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge\-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

**About you**


You are a hands\-on engineer with strong technical aptitude, curiosity and a passion for using AI to build useful software. You enjoy learning through experimentation, working with others and turning ideas into practical solutions in a fast\-moving environment.

**Experience**

* Practical experience using AI development tools to build or prototype solutions; this may come from professional experience, personal projects or independent experimentation.
* Good understanding of software engineering principles and experience working with code.
* Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or similar.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and AI\-enabled software development workflows.
* Evidence of having built or delivered something practical, with an interest in progressing prototypes towards production.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to engage with business and technology colleagues.


Experience with some of the following would be useful; we do not expect candidates to have experience across all areas:

* Java, Python, C\#, TypeScript or similar languages
* AWS, Azure or GCP
* Docker and Kubernetes
* Git\-based development workflows
* REST APIs and event\-driven architectures
* Test automation and Infrastructure as Code
* Observability and monitoring tools


Experience in Asset Management, Investment Management or Financial Services is desirable but not essential.

**Personal Attributes**

* Curious, creative and enthusiastic about experimenting with AI.
* Strong aptitude and willingness to learn new technologies quickly.
* Pragmatic and comfortable learning from approaches that do not work.
* Collaborative, adaptable and comfortable working across business and technology teams.
* Delivery\-focused and motivated by turning ideas into useful outcomes.
* Comfortable working with some ambiguity while seeking guidance when needed.

**Behavioural Expectations**

**Brave**

* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.

**Bold**

* Set clear, outcome\-led direction and make decisive trade\-offs.
* Simplify processes and governance where possible.
* Empower teams through effective decision making.

**Curious**

* Drive continuous prioritisation based on outcomes, data and evidence.
* Challenge assumptions and encourage innovative thinking.
* Use delivery metrics and business outcomes to inform decision making.

**Compassionate**

* Act as a visible advocate for client and business outcomes.
* Foster collaboration, trust and psychological safety.
* Balance delivery pace with sustainable ways of working.

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

**Woon je (in de buurt van) het vierkant Zwolle, Meppel, Emmeloord en Lelystad? Ben jij iemand die graag sleutelt aan techniek, energie krijgt van klantcontact én op zoek is naar een afwisselende buitendienstfunctie? Dan horen we dat natuurlijk graag!**

**Wat ga je doen?**

Als **Field Service Engineer** ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van **hoogwaardige service** en ondersteuning aan onze klanten. Tijdens reparaties en onderhoud stel je diagnoses en bied je **technische oplossingen** voor Domino\-apparatuur, accessoires en toepassingen. Je onderscheidt je door net dat extra stapje te zetten en actief mee te denken met de klant over mogelijke **verbeteringen** voor de toekomst.

**Taken en verantwoordelijkheden**

* Verrichten van preventieve onderhoudswerkzaamheden bij klanten
* Zelfstandig storingen oplossen
* Ondersteunen bij nieuwe installaties
* Adviseren van de klant over verbeteringen, uitbreidingen en innovaties
* Proactief acties initiëren indien nodig
* Dagelijks rapportages creëren

**Wij zoeken jou!**

Jij gaat technische uitdagingen niet uit de weg en hebt affiniteit met productieomgevingen, computers en netwerken. Daarnaast ben je oplossingsgericht, besluitvaardig en pak je problemen proactief aan. Binnen onze organisatie stimuleren we bold behaviours: je vereenvoudigt waar mogelijk, daagt uit wanneer nodig, durft te beslissen en zorgt dat er geleverd wordt. Je herkent jezelf in onze kernwaarden: samenwerken, luisteren, expertise, ambitie en verantwoordelijkheid.

En verder ben je....

* technisch onderlegd met minimaal een afgeronde technische MBO\-opleiding (niveau 3 of 4\) of werkervaring in dit vakgebied en heb je technisch EN mechanisch inzicht,
* communicatief sterk in Nederlands en Engels,
* in staat om jouw analytische vermogen in te zetten om tot de kern van het probleem te komen en de beste langetermijnoplossing te bieden aan de klanten van Domino,
* flexibel en klantgericht,
* een teamspeler.

**Wat bieden wij jou?**

Je komt te werken bij een mooi internationaal bedrijf, waar de lijnen kort zijn en er een fijne werksfeer is. Daarnaast bieden wij:

* Een afwisselende baan met veel zelfstandigheid
* Volop groeikansen binnen de organisatie, zowel nationaal als internationaal
* Een aantrekkelijk salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden
* Bonusregeling
* Laptop, mobiele telefoon en een auto van de zaak, die ook privé gebruikt kan worden
* Toegang tot (interne) opleidingen, trainingen en professionele tools
* 25 vakantiedagen – mogelijkheid om 3 vakantiedagen te verdienen in een bonus\-/malusregeling en/of 5 dagen per jaar bij te kopen (naar rato)
* Werken in een superleuk team

**Solliciteer nu!**

Ben je enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct via onderstaande link of stuur een bericht naar **werkenbij@dominobenelux.com**.

Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie? Neem gerust contact op met  
**William van de Vrugt**.  
Tel: 030 \- 636 3333 (algemeen) of **06 200 356 82**

www.dominobenelux.com

*Over Ons*

*Je kent ons waarschijnlijk niet maar je ziet ons elke dag. Je hoeft maar een supermarkt in te lopen en wij liggen in elk schap. Als ik aan je vraag of je wel eens naar de houdbaarheidsdatum op een pak melk hebt gekeken, dan zeg je vast ja.*

*Dan heb je onbewust al met ons kennis gemaakt*

*Die datum wordt namelijk geprint door industriële printers van Domino. Als je erover na gaat denken, dan staan we eigenlijk al in je koelkast of in de voorraadkast. Onze klanten zijn productiebedrijven zoals Coca\-Cola, Philips en Unilever. Onze apparatuur print informatie zoals houdbaarheidsdata en traceerbaarheidscodes op verpakkingen. Die codes vind je op o.a. levensmiddelen, dranken en geneesmiddelen. Wij zorgen voor de oplossingen en kennis om producten te identificeren en traceren, zodat ze met de juiste informatie en op het juiste moment in de gewenste handen terecht komen.*

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: From €3\.100,00 per month

### **Descriptions \& requirements**

Job description
**Overview of the job**  

This is a non\-operational instructional job in an establishment.  

**Summary**  

The job holder will be responsible for providing supervision, knowledge and skills to prisoners in a specialist workshop so they can improve their employment prospects on release with a view to reducing reoffending.The job holder will ensure that all services are provided to a high standard and that security and control is maintained at all times. The job holder will be able to teach prisoners towards achieving nationally recognised qualifications and may be supported by external organisations such as local colleges.

  

This job description is not for use by job holders in basic assembly/packing workshops, instead Production Instructor – Enterprises should be used. However, on an exceptional short term basis job holders can supervise prisoners in more basic workshops.
  

  

This is a non\-operational job in an establishment with no line management responsibilities. **Responsibilities, Activities and Duties**  

The job holder will be required to carry out the following responsibilities, activities and duties
  

* May participate in the selection process of prisoners for the workshop/area of work.
* Induct prisoners to the workshop/area of work and train them in aspects such as Health and Safety, Control of Substance Hazardous to Health (COSHH), machinery and tools usage.
* Provide support for prisoners w required; tailor learning and training requirements to individual needs.
* Set work schedules and manage targets/quality standards, maintaining delivery of contractual arrangements.
* Assess and evaluate skills of prisoners up to national qualification standards.
* Supervise and maintain discipline of prisoners within workshop/area of work, responsible for performance, motivation, discipline, appraisal and development of prisoners.
* Maintain regular communications via radio net in accordance with Local Security Strategy (LSS).
* Open and complete Assessment Care in Custody and Teamwork (ACCT) forms, Violence Reduction Incident Reports (VRIR) and Security Information Reports (SIRs) when required and contribute to Incentive Earned Privileges (IEP) reports.
* Will conduct a metal detector scan or rub down search of prisoners attending and leaving their own workshops.
* Provide quality assurance against product specification.
* Log attendance and approve prisoner hours worked and wages including recording piece work w appropriate.
* Carry out fabric and tool checks of workshops and maintain security of areas, logging any tool/equipment faults. Undertake planned maintenance programme on machinery.
* Contribute to prisoner reports including parole and sentence planning.
* Complete regime monitoring information and update prisoner training records.
* Contribute to Health and Safety risk assessments relating to the workshop/area of work and specialist areas.
* Request materials and estimate usage in order to meet work targets.
* Initiate product development reviews to maintain workshop/area of work output levels, and to provide variety of work and experience for prisoners.
* Participate in self\-audit and in achieving Service Delivery Indicators (SDIs).
* Complete administration activities to support the smooth running of the workshop.


  

The duties/responsibilities listed above describe the post as it is at present and is not intended to be exhaustive. The job holder is expected to accept reasonable alterations and additional tasks of a similar level that may be necessary. Significant adjustments may require re\-examination under the Job Evaluation Scheme and shall be discussed in the first instance with the job holder.  

  

An ability to fulfil all spoken aspects of the role with confidence through the medium of English or (w specified in Wales) Welsh.

* Making Effective Decisions

* Preferable for candidate to have some supervisory experience

To support your growth, we've introduced the Babcock Role Framework, which outlines roles, career pathways, and development opportunities. With every job mapped to these frameworks, you’ll have a transparent view of the steps needed to reach Senior Engineer and beyond.
  
  

What rewards and benefits will you get?
  
  

We want you to feel supported, valued and excited about what’s ahead. That’s why we offer a comprehensive package designed to support your development, your wellbeing and your life outside of work too.
  
  

In addition to a minimum starting salary of £35,000, you’ll benefit from:
  
  

A minimum of 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays
  
Generous pension and employee share schemes
  
Flexible benefits, including cycle to work scheme, discounts
  
Wellbeing support, covering mental, physical, financial, and social wellbeing, with services like our Employee Assistance Programme, digital GP service, and health checks.
  
  

You’ll also have the chance to get involved in our STEM outreach activities and volunteering opportunities.
  
  

What do you need to apply?
  
  

You'll need to have achieved, or be on track to achieve, a BEng, MEng, BSc, or MSc in a STEM discipline. We welcome applicants from a broad range of subjects, including Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and emerging technology fields such as AI, Machine Learning, Robotics, and Cybernetics.
  
Many of our programmes are subject to Security Clearance and Trade Control restrictions which mean that your place of birth, nationality, citizenship, or residency you hold or have held may impact which programmes you are eligible for. For this programme, you must be able to achieve and maintain Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) and Security Check (SC) security clearance. For further details, visit GOV.UK and search ‘United Kingdom Security Vetting: clearance levels’.
  
  

Where will you be based?
  
  

Places on our Systems Engineering programme for September 2027 are available in Rosyth, Scotland.
  
  

Our 320\-acre Rosyth facility is home to one of the UK’s largest and most advanced waterside manufacturing and repair sites. As a graduate, you could be involved in supporting the full lifecycle of naval vessels or helping deliver complex, large\-scale marine build projects. Whether you're working on new\-build programmes or enhancing existing systems, your role will be vital in delivering dependable, mission\-ready solutions across the marine industry.

Application process and important information
  
  

Applications are reviewed in the order they are received, and if there’s a high level of interest in this programme, we may close applications earlier than advertised. To give yourself the best chance of being considered, we recommend submitting your application and completing any required online assessments as soon as possible.

What will you do on the programme?
  
  

Civil and structural engineering is about shaping the world around us – designing, building and maintaining the infrastructure that society depends on every day. It’s about making sure structures are strong, stable and safe. Working within our Cavendish Nuclear business, you’ll put these principles into practice on projects that truly matter.
  
  

As a graduate, you’ll contribute to high\-profile infrastructure and defence projects across naval and nuclear operations. You could help build the next generation of nuclear power stations, modernise dockyards to support a modern naval fleet, or maintain critical facilities that keep the UK’s defence and energy sectors running smoothly. You’ll be involved in designing, constructing and maintaining complex infrastructure, ensuring buildings and structures are robust, resilient and fit for purpose.
  
  

You’ll be part of a team delivering smarter, safer infrastructure that makes a real difference to the UK’s defence and energy future.
  
  

How is the programme structured?
  
  

This is an exciting two\-year programme made up of a series of placements designed to give you broad experience across civil and structural engineering.
  
  

You’ll rotate through different teams and projects, developing your knowledge of structural assessments, design documentation, compliance processes and operational site support. These rotations offer opportunities to broaden your experience – and some may even take you to different locations – helping you build your professional network and deepen your understanding of how the business operates.
  
  

Each placement gives you the chance to apply what you’ve learned, take on real responsibilities and discover the areas of the discipline that interest you most.
  
  

How do we develop and support you?
  
  

From day one, you’ll receive structured support, personalised training, and dedicated mentorship to help you excel throughout your programme and beyond.
  
  

You’ll join our Graduate Development Programme, featuring expert\-led masterclasses on communication, personal branding, resilience, and wellbeing.
  
  

To support your journey toward Chartered or Incorporated Engineer status, we offer full guidance and cover all associated fees.
  
  

What’s waiting for you after the programme?
  
  

Once you complete the programme, you’ll move into a permanent role within our Engineering Function, where you can continue applying and expanding the skills you've developed. You’ll also have the opportunity to build on your progress toward professional registration, a recognised benchmark of engineering competence, which can support your journey into more advanced roles, such as Senior Engineer.
  
  

As a global organisation, Babcock provides countless opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. To support your growth, we've introduced the Babcock Role Framework, which outlines roles, career pathways, and development opportunities. With every job mapped to these frameworks, you’ll have a transparent view of the steps needed to reach Senior Engineer and beyond.
  
  

What rewards and benefits will you get?
  
  

We want you to feel supported, valued and excited about what’s ahead. That’s why we offer a comprehensive package designed to support your development, your wellbeing and your life outside of work too.
  
  

In addition to a minimum starting salary of £35,000, you’ll benefit from:
  
  

A minimum of 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays
  
Generous pension and employee share schemes
  
Flexible benefits, including cycle to work scheme, discounts
  
Wellbeing support, covering mental, physical, financial, and social wellbeing, with services like our Employee Assistance Programme, digital GP service, and health checks.
  
  

You’ll also have the chance to get involved in our STEM outreach activities and volunteering opportunities.

You'll need to have achieved, or be on track to achieve, a BEng or MEng in one of the following subjects: Civil and Coastal Engineering, Civil and Structural Engineering, or Civil Engineering. Many of our programmes are subject to Security Clearance and Trade Control restrictions which mean that your place of birth, nationality, citizenship, or residency you hold or have held may impact which programmes you are eligible for. For further details, visit GOV.UK and search ‘United Kingdom Security Vetting: clearance levels.

ska fungera optimalt förlitar sig vårt nätverk med över 1 000 servicetekniker runtom i Europa –

mjukvaruverktyg.

ägarskap över centrala applikationer som vårt fältverktyg **SWDL (Software Download)** samt

vardagen för våra testingenjörer i labbet vid verifiering av värmepumpar.

med C\# och .NET\-ekosystemet (.NET Framework / moderna .NET).

**Stötta labbingenjörer:** Utveckla intuitiva verktyg för dataloggning, monitorering och diagnostik som används av testingenjörer för att fånga och analysera systembeteenden i realtid vid labbtester.

 **Kvalifikationer** **Utbildning:** Högskole\- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom datateknik, elektroteknik,  

mjukvaruteknik eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet.

och .NET.
